throughput_environment: Apple Silicon local test harness (PostgreSQL + Python Decimal)
denominator_definition: Total valid normalized payment records processed across 4 counterparty streams in the synthetic evaluation batch.
data_scope: Synthetic multi-source dataset (60 payments, 54 bank credits, 58 settlements, 3 refunds) with hidden ground truth
deterministic_vs_ai: Deterministic rules execute 100% of mathematical matching, parity verification, and exception typing. AI (grounded RAG) acts as an advisory assistant retrieving governing SOP policies without authority to approve or move funds.

exception_categories.label: Missing Bank Credit Verification
exception_categories.resolution_path: Nodal bank ledger search and UTR clearing claim

exception_categories.label: Settlement Payout Shortfall
exception_categories.resolution_path: Gateway fee clawback dispute or approved commercial waiver

exception_categories.label: Customer Refund Unadjusted in Payout
exception_categories.resolution_path: Clawback unadjusted refund in next settlement batch

exception_categories.label: Commercial Fee Tier Deviation
exception_categories.resolution_path: Demand fee reconciliation credit note from gateway

exception_categories.label: Duplicate Customer Charge Detected
exception_categories.resolution_path: Initiate customer reversal refund for duplicate capture

exception_categories.label: Captured Gross Unremitted by Gateway
exception_categories.resolution_path: Escalate T+2 SLA breach to payment gateway operations

exception_categories.label: Duplicate Bank Statement Credit
exception_categories.resolution_path: Audit nodal bank statement journal and reverse shadow credit

exception_categories.label: Ambiguous Candidate Settlement Matches
exception_categories.resolution_path: Manual timestamp and acquirer reference link
